description: This file provides utility functions for mapping statuses and strings to deterministic or themed colors, primarily used for visualizations on dark backgrounds. It includes functions for generating consistent pastel colors from strings and mapping common status terms to theme colors.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel-like HSL color string from an input string, ensuring distinct hues for different strings suited for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps common status strings to theme-specific colors; falls back to a deterministic color from the string if no known status matches.
